examples.english: And My Father said unto Mouriel the angel, 'Behold, the man whom I created in My image hath transgressed the commandment which I gave him.

examples.english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, 'My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.'
